# Saltmarsh: I'm taking it over

**From:** Bettina Kroll  
**To:** Sofia Marchetti, Kwame Adjei-Rowe  
**Cc:** Ruth Calloway  
**Date:** 10/1/25  
**Subject:** Re: Saltmarsh: I'm taking it over

Hi team,

Quick update following my 1:1 with Sofia this morning. Effective 10/6/25, I am stepping in to take over Saltmarsh Provisions from Sofia myself. 

Right now the churn risk on SMP is just too high after the reefer bay backups at their North Charleston facility last Tuesday. Corinne Ashdown escalated twice about the Gatehouse Kiosk check-in lag on Doors 12–18, and they need daily hand-holding while eng works on ticket #4419. 

Sofia will keep Covey & Lark Retail so she can focus 100% on getting their Hagerstown DC ready for holiday peak without SMP eating up her entire calendar. 

**Transition checklist before 10/6/25:**
- **Sofia:** Send me your raw notes from the 9/29/25 call with Corinne Ashdown and the latest Carrier Detention export CSV.
- **Me:** Intro email to Corinne on Friday morning and take over the Monday 8am dock walk-through call.
- **Kwame:** Nothing changes on your end, just flagging in case Corinne's night dispatcher calls the main Coastal support line by mistake again.

Thanks Sofia for flagging the heat on this one early! Let me know if you need anything else before Friday.

Best,  
Bettina

---

> **From:** Sofia Marchetti  
> **To:** Bettina Kroll  
> **Date:** 10/1/25
